Vue: withDefaults().description:
Vue 2.7+ `<script setup>`, or Vue 2.6 and below via [unplugin-vue2-script-setup](https://www.npmjs.com/package/unplugin-vue2-script-setup). TS only.
Supplies default values for a type-based `defineProps` declaration.
**compiler macro** only usable inside `<script setup>`. It does not need to be imported, and is compiled away when `<script setup>` is processed.

Vue: defineOptions().description:
**Vue 3.3+ only — not supported by Vue 2.7 `<script setup>` nor by [unplugin-vue2-script-setup](https://www.npmjs.com/package/unplugin-vue2-script-setup) (as of 0.11.4).**
In Vue 2, put the options in a second, plain `<script>` block alongside `<script setup>`.
**compiler macro** only usable inside `<script setup>`.

Vue: defineModel().description:
**Vue 3.4+ only — not supported by Vue 2.7 `<script setup>` nor by [unplugin-vue2-script-setup](https://www.npmjs.com/package/unplugin-vue2-script-setup) (as of 0.11.4).**
In Vue 2, declare the prop and emit the update event by hand, or use the `model` component option.
Example:
`const model = defineModel('<name>', { required: true, default: 0 });`
`<ChildComponent v-model:<name>="value" />` === `<ChildComponent :<name>="value" @update:<name>="value = $event" />`
In 3.x `v-model` on the custom component is an equivalent of passing a `modelValue` prop and emitting an `update:modelValue` event: `<ChildComponent v-model="value" />` === `<ChildComponent :modelValue="value" @update:modelValue="value = $event" />`

Vue: defineSlots().description:
**Vue 3.3+ only (TS only) — not supported by Vue 2.7 `<script setup>` nor by [unplugin-vue2-script-setup](https://www.npmjs.com/package/unplugin-vue2-script-setup) (as of 0.11.4).**
In Vue 2, type slots through `useSlots()` instead.
Provide type hints to IDEs for slot name and props type checking.
**compiler macro** only usable inside `<script setup>`.
